evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-11-02, told Dave that last week (~2023-10-26) he threw a small party at his Japanese mansion (see ## New home (2023-03-23)) for his new album — "It was amazing, so much love from my fam and friends!" (the 2023-10-29 update above had his album at "almost finished") — and shared photos of the party: a group of people sitting in a room with a projector screen ("Take a look at the photo of the party in the mansion, it was so energizing!"), a group of people dancing at the party, and a group of people standing on top of a stage [S28T1][S28T3][S28T5].
- On 2023-11-02, when Dave asked what it was like when everyone was cheering him on: "It was incredible, Dave! The room was buzzing with energy and love. It was a powerful reminder of why I'm doing this." [S28T4][S28T5].
- On 2023-11-02, said creating something that people connect with and brings joy "is what I'm all about," and moments like the party "really motivate me to keep growing!" (complements his earlier "passion and purpose" remark of 2023-10-25, see above) [S28T7].
- On 2023-11-02, in the chat's closing music exchange, said "Wow Dave! Music really has a way of touching our souls." — that connection is what he's aiming for with his music (complements his long-stated belief that music is his "passion and purpose"/"fuels my soul," see above; studio details in ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) [S28T25][S28T27].
- On 2023-11-02, the chat then moved on: Dave cheered Calvin on — "Wow, Calvin, that's awesome! Keep up the great work!" — and shared a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notepad on it; Calvin asked whether the notebook helps Dave stay connected to the creative process (Dave: it's for writing lyrics and notes — "writing lyrics boosts my motivation to grow") and asked what tunes Dave's been listening to lately (Dave: classic rock — "the music from that era is timeless") (conversation flow in the 2023-11-02 entry of ## Relationships; Dave's details in the Music section of /memories/dave.md) [S28T32][S28T33][S28T34][S28T39][S28T40].

- As of 2023-08-11, has a music studio setup with a high-quality sound system; offered Calvin a hand with his music stuff ("if you need a hand with your music stuff, just let me know!") — "You won't believe how amazing your songs sound here!" — and shared a photo of the setup (a desk with a keyboard, monitor, and keyboard pad); Calvin thanked him but said he's "super busy with my music stuff at the moment" and will keep the offer in mind [S13T15][S13T16].
- Last weekend before 2023-09-15 (~2023-09-09/10), attended a rock concert in Boston — "take a look at what an amazing atmosphere it was!" — and shared a photo of a band performing on stage with bright lights [S19T1].
- On 2023-09-22, invited Calvin to jam some music together — "'California Love' is a classic! Let me know if you wanna jam some music together!" — and Calvin accepted; the two are now looking forward to an awesome jam session and creating something special (conversation flow in ## Relationships; Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S20T9][S20T10][S20T11][S20T16].
- Just before 2023-10-15, told Calvin he just got back from a music festival — "it was amazing! The energy, the music, the crowd - sooo good. I felt so alive!"; shared a photo from the event of the main stage (a photo of a stage with a crowd of people watching a band) — "The main stage was unreal. The headliner was so good and the vibe was unreal!"; Calvin asked for photos from the festival to "join in on the fun" and asked who the headliner was; Dave answered (late in the chat, [S23T9]): The Fireworks headlined the festival, and Calvin said he "heard great things" about them (Calvin's side in the 2023-10-15 entry of the Relationships section of /memories/calvin.md) [S23T5][S23T6][S23T7][S23T8][S23T9].
- On 2023-10-23, while praising the attention to detail in Calvin's music ("Loving the attention to detail in your work, it makes it extra special. Keep on creating!"), shared a photo of his amp (a brown amp with a black knob and a brown cover) (conversation flow in the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; Calvin's record photo in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T23].
- On 2023-10-23, in the closing exchange about concerts: said the good times he's had at concerts last month (~September 2023 — e.g., the Boston rock concert ~2023-09-09/10, see above) remind him that "music has a way of connecting us and making memories," and shared a photo of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air ("the atmosphere was amazing!"); said concerts "bring people together and create such a cool vibe" — "you can feel the energy in the air" — sharing another concert photo (a crowd of people standing around a stage — "this unforgettable moment that I captured"); Calvin: concerts are what he lives for, the "indescribable connection between the artist and the crowd"; Dave: "So glad you get to experience that!" and, wishing Calvin "many more electrifying moments in the spotlight," closed with "See you soon!" (Calvin's side in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T25][S25T27][S25T29][S25T31].
- On 2023-11-02, in the closing exchange of the chat, agreed that music "can really move us" — "It's almost like a language for our souls." (Calvin: "Music really has a way of touching our souls." — Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S28T25][S28T26]. Asked Calvin how he likes hanging out in his studio and whether he watches much TV; Calvin: he only works in the studio — his separate relaxation room with a TV is "a great way to unwind and get inspired" — and he usually watches music videos, concerts, and documentaries about artists and their creative process (Calvin's studio and TV details in the Recording studio and Music sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S28T28][S28T30]. Then: "Wow, Calvin, that's awesome! Keep up the great work! Take a look at the photo!" — sharing a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notepad on it (the chat continued past this — Calvin's follow-ups about the notebook, focus, and what he's listening to are in the 2023-11-02 entry of ## Relationships) [S28T31][S28T32].

- On 2023-09-13, got excited about the upcoming tour: "Yay! Dave! We're hitting some awesome spots - it's gonna be epic!" [S18T9].
- On 2023-09-15, reacted to Dave's update that the night before (2023-09-14) he and his band had been jamming: "When everything just clicks during a jam session, it's such a great feeling." He asked if Dave had recordings of the sessions, and when Dave said no ("way too into it and totally forgot"), said "Aww, bummer! I would've loved to hear that music," adding that "some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio" — "those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds." Dave also told him he attended a rock concert in Boston last weekend (~2023-09-09/10) with an "amazing atmosphere" (photo of a band on stage with bright lights); Calvin: "Rock concerts always have such an electrifying atmosphere!" (Dave's details in the Rock band and Music sections of /memories/dave.md) [S19T1][S19T2][S19T3][S19T4].
- Childhood song: one song "always makes [him] smile" — it played during a road trip with his dad, and they "had so much fun singing along to it"; on 2023-09-22, when Dave asked the name of the song, Calvin: "We used to rock a song by Tupac and Dr. Dre called 'California Love.' Ah, those were the days!"; Dave called the song a classic and invited Calvin to jam some music together, and Calvin agreed ("Yeah, let's do it! That would be awesome.") — the two are looking forward to an awesome jam session and creating something special (conversation flow in the 2023-09-22 entry of ## Relationships) [S20T6][S20T8][S20T9][S20T10][S20T16].
- On 2023-10-04, told Dave he met with some "incredible" artists in Boston the day before (2023-10-03) and talked about working together — the meeting was arranged through a mutual friend ("knew we'd be a great fit"); he found it "inspiring and exciting" because each artist has an individual style, and he's "stoked to collaborate with them on new music"; when Dave asked about it and to let him know how it goes, Calvin: "Can't wait to show you the final result." [S21T1][S21T2][S21T3].
- On 2023-10-04, when Dave asked what he works on to relax, Calvin shared a photo of a shiny orange car with its hood open and said he loves working on this project "to chill out" (a car project Calvin is working on himself — distinct from his own Ferrari, see ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26); makes sense given his long-standing finding that working on/fixing cars relaxes him "like meditation," see the 2023-05-31 entry in ## Relationships) [S21T3].

- On 2023-07-21, told Dave he is working on a project to transform his Japanese mansion into a recording studio — it has been his dream to have a space for creating music with other artists, and the studio is "my sanctuary that reminds [him] why [he] loves music" (home is the mansion from ## New home (2023-03-23); earlier studio photos are under ## Music); shared a photo of the progress so far (a room with a ladder in it) [S11T4].
- Has been experimenting with different genres lately, pushing himself out of his comfort zone — adding electronic elements to his songs gives them "a fresh vibe"; he calls it "an exciting process of self-discovery and growth" [S11T6].
- Finds switching between styles challenging — "it's a matter of finding the right balance between sticking to [his] sound and trying new stuff"; "it can be intimidating, but that's what makes it so exciting and keeps [him] motivated to keep going!" [S11T8].
- On 2023-11-02, said the connection music creates with people is "that connection I'm aiming for with my music" (his goal for his music; complements his 2023-10-25 "passion and purpose" remark — see ## Music) [S28T27].
- On 2023-11-02, shared a photo of the studio setup (a recording studio with a monitor, keyboard, and monitor) — Calvin: "Take a loot at my studio setup, that's look awesome, isn't it?"; Dave: "Wow, your studio looks stunning!" [S28T27].
- On 2023-11-02, when Dave asked how he likes hanging out there and whether he watches much TV: he only works in the studio; he has a separate room for relaxation with a TV (photo of a living room with a couch, chair, television and a table — "that room is cozy and relaxing"), which is "a great way to unwind and get inspired" [S28T29].
- On 2023-11-02, when Dave asked what he usually watches on it: he usually watches music videos, concerts, and documentaries about artists and their creative process — "It's cool to learn more about the industry and see what others do." — and it's "a source of inspiration for me" [S28T31].
- On 2023-11-13, when Dave asked whether he's tried out any new ideas lately: he's having fun trying out new sounds and pushing the boundaries — he likes going for new ideas and seeing where they take him, because "always gotta stay ahead in this" (a continuation of his 2023-07-21 experimenting-with-genres thread above; Dave: "Experimenting and pushing boundaries is key to making our art grow") [S29T14][S29T15][S29T16].

- On 2023-08-31, told Dave that last weekend (~2023-08-25/26) he started shooting a video for his new album (the album in progress since 2023-06-09, see ## Music) — "can't wait for you to check it out!" — and shared a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach ("Look how great it was!"); Dave: "Can't wait to see it", and asked whether it will be shot on location [S16T6][S16T7].
- The shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach — "It's going to have some epic visuals!" [S16T8].
- Dave loves the beaches in Miami and can't wait to see them; Calvin: "I love the Miami vibe, it's perfect for the vid. Can't wait to show you!" [S16T9][S16T10].

- On 2023-05-31, reconnected with Dave ("been ages since we chatted") and told him the Frank Ocean tour the week before was "wild", including the "unreal" Tokyo show (details in ## Tokyo trip); Dave congratulated him [S7T1][S7T2]. Calvin thought Dave's car photo was of the car Dave had been fixing the engine of for a friend (Dave's neighbor; details in /memories/dave.md, section "Car maintenance shop"). The two also talked about how working on cars is relaxing: for Calvin it "chill[s]" him, "clears [his] head", "calms [him] down", and gives a real sense of achievement — "like meditating" — and Dave said the same applies to him (details in /memories/dave.md, section "Hobbies and sense of purpose") [S7T3][S7T4][S7T5][S7T6].
- The 2023-05-31 conversation continued: Calvin echoed Dave's "feeling of power and happiness" from the transformation talk — "It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas" [S7T9]. Dave asked whether he always enjoys performing live (see ## Music), then what's next for his music; Calvin named the Boston stop on the Frank Ocean tour — "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (see the Boston trip section above) [S7T10][S7T11][S7T14][S7T15]. Dave said he'll be at the Boston show to cheer him on [S7T16]. The 2023-05-31 conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to [him]" — and saying he can't wait to experience the Boston music scene; Dave wished him a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when he gets back, and Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details, signing off "See you soon!" [S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].
- On 2023-06-09, caught up with Dave: told him about the creative-team album session (details in ## Music) and that he's "stoked" about the album; Dave shared a photo of a pond with a boat in it surrounded by trees, and Calvin shared a photo of the studio (details in ## Music) and one of a tree with pink flowers (details in ## Boston trip) [S8T1][S8T2][S8T3][S8T5]. They talked about nature: Dave has been exploring parks on weekends to relax; Calvin, having never been to Boston, is "can't wait" to visit in July 2023 and asked about the Boston parks (details in ## Boston trip); when Calvin asked if Dave has been on any hikes recently, Dave said no but thinks hiking is awesome — "being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights"; details on Dave's park habit and his Boston-parks stroll are in /memories/dave.md > ## Parks [S8T4][S8T5][S8T6][S8T7][S8T8]. Then Dave announced he had booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023), and Calvin said he wants to go on a hike in the mountains to de-stress himself (details in ## Mountains and hiking); the two wished each other well for the trip and signed off "see you soon" (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Mountain trip (July 2023)) [S8T9][S8T10][S8T11][S8T12][S8T13][S8T14].
- On 2023-06-21, told Dave about the car accident and repair process (details in ## Car accident (2023-06-16)); Dave expressed sympathy that no one was hurt, asked about issues with the insurance process and how long it took, and asked about the mechanic in the garage photo [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].
- The 2023-06-21 conversation continued: Calvin answered Dave's skiing question — never tried it, but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might try it once (details in ## Mountains and hiking) [S9T17]. Dave then announced that he recently joined a rock band and has been practicing guitar, sharing a photo of the band; Calvin said it's awesome and will bring him a lot of emotions, and Dave said good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions (details in the Rock band section of /memories/dave.md). The conversation closed with Dave saying he had to go and "I'll see you soon!", and Calvin thanking Dave and saying "let's keep in touch, take care!" [S9T18][S9T19][S9T20][S9T21].
